patch.explanation: display_name() subscripted profile["name"] without handling an empty upstream payload, so a None profile raised TypeError (and a missing 'name' key would raise KeyError), producing the HTTP 500 on GET /api/user/profile. The fix adds a single guard at the top of the function that returns "anonymous" when the profile is None/empty or has no usable 'name', which matches the function's documented contract and makes the existing tests test_display_name_empty_payload and test_display_name_missing_name
